articles.headline: Sources - Sparks trade All-Star guard Kelsey Plum to Mercury
articles.description: The Sparks are trading five-time All-Star Kelsey Plum to the Mercury for Monique Akoa Makani, a 2027 first-round pick and a 2028 second-rounder, sources told ESPN.

articles.headline: Cheryl Reeve advocates for trans athletes before Fever game
articles.description: Lynx coach Cheryl Reeve reiterated her support for trans athletes ahead of her team's game against the Fever, saying "every kid has a right to sports."

articles.headline: Inside the disunited United States that shadows the WNBA
articles.description: Sophie Cunningham said what she said about transgender women in sports. Now others want their say, whether the WNBA wants to hear them or not.

images.name: Sophie Cunningham [800x450]
images.caption: Sophie Cunningham, who has become a polarizing figure in the WNBA since sharing her opinion on transgender women in sports, signs autographs Friday night before Indiana's game at Portland.

images.name: Sophie Cunningham [800x450]
images.caption: "I'm here to play basketball," Cunningham said Friday night before scoring 13 points in Indiana's win over Portland.

images.name: Sophie Cunningham celebration [800x450]
images.caption: Cunningham drew more boos than cheers, but that didn't dampen her celebration on a night when she made three 3-pointers.

images.name: Sophie Cunningham supporters [800x450]
images.caption: Cunningham drew supporters in Portland and Seattle. Another rally is reportedly scheduled for the Fever's game in Minnesota on Sunday.

images.name: Portland protest [800x533]
images.caption: Demonstrators on both sides of the transgender athlete issue showed up outside the Moda Center Friday night in Portland.

articles.headline: Sky's Sydney Taylor lets it 'fly,' dumps Aces with 'big' late 3-pointer
articles.description: Sydney Taylor became the first rookie in franchise history to hit a go-ahead 3-pointer in the final five seconds of the fourth quarter or overtime Saturday to beat the defending champion Las Vegas Aces 84-83.

images.name: Sydney Taylor [600x400]
images.caption: Sky rookie Sydney Taylor on hitting her late game-winning 3 against the Aces: "That's probably one of the biggest shots of my career in my life."

articles.headline: Ionescu has 27 points, 10 rebounds as Liberty edge Mercury 94-92
articles.description: — Sabrina Ionescu had 27 points and 10 assists, Han Xu scored 17 points off the bench, and the New York Liberty edged the Phoenix Mercury 94-92 on Saturday.
